infobox.usage: Unlocks the negotiation room inside the Zmeisky 6 building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: "Negotiation" room key (Negotiation) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the room for important meetings inside one of the city offices.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Corporate Perks

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: In the middle office inside the Zmeisky 6 building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the negotiation room inside the Zmeisky 6 building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Drinks, Building materials, Electronics)
- Medbag
- PC block
- Relaxation room key spawn location on the metal table
